root_cause.text: The driver mixes a non-managed SPI controller allocation (`spi_alloc_host`) with a managed registration (`devm_spi_register_controller`), causing a double-free because both the manual error path (`spi_controller_put`) and the device core’s automatic cleanup attempt to free the same controller when probe fails.
root_cause.evidence: The commit message states: "The driver currently uses spi_alloc_host() to allocate the controller but registers it using devm_spi_register_controller(). If devm_register_restart_handler() fails, the code jumps to the put_ctlr label and calls spi_controller_put(). However, since the controller was registered via a devm function, the device core will automatically call spi_controller_put() again when the probe fails. This results in a double-free of the spi_controller structure." The patch changes the allocation to `devm_spi_alloc_host` and removes all goto `put_ctlr` paths, instead returning errors directly (which triggers devm cleanup).
